findings.reason: the honest change is to reuse the multi-machine layout for a one-machine bundle; absent that argument the plan should say why not, and either sentence changes the design text and §9's edit set.
findings.text: §9's flat layout holds `machine_map.json`, `maps/<ids>.json` and `machine_description/<phase>/<ids>.nc`, which is a second addressing path branching `MapBundle.machine_map_path`/`signal_map_path` and unknown bundle support into `load_bundle_descriptor`, while the existing multi-machine layout already expresses a single-machine bundle as `machines: ["<name>"]`; the section gives the lead's layout preference but no engineering reason the existing layout cannot carry one machine, which is the justification a parallel branch in three permanent readers owes.

findings.reason: the plan already names settings.py as the resolution owner and the install folder as the install-time setting, so a one-line note naming the installer as the sole creator of the layout closes it without a design change.
findings.text: the facility layout is asserted in two places with no single owner: packages/imas-alambic/install/imasdb.sh (§5) creates `maps/<version>`/`maps/current` and `ids/`, and settings.py (§8) re-derives `$IMAS_ALAMBIC_HOME/maps/current` and `$IMAS_ALAMBIC_HOME/ids`, so a change to either name must be made in both, exactly the drift the plan removes for the /work side by naming imas_ambix/data/paths.py as the one owner.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §8 hides precedence, home-derivation, machine inference and per-setting source behind one call, settings.resolve_settings(flags), and §9 extends the existing MapBundle.machine_map_path/signal_map_path/load_bundle_descriptor rather than adding a parallel reader.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the facility IMASDB layout has two owners with no single named owner, an install shell script that creates `<home>/maps/current` and `<home>/ids` (§5) and settings.py that re-derives the same two paths from IMAS_ALAMBIC_HOME (§8), in contrast to imas_ambix/data/paths.py, which the plan correctly names as the one owner of the /work layout (§1).
